standard.summary: 训练 Pilot：盯着梯度范数，出状况就按比例调学习率。这个字段选策略，off = 整个功能关闭。
standard.effect: 默认 off = 完全不变（历史声明默认曾是 population，已按“默认对齐现实”改掉）。population = 额外监控离群层；heuristic = 只看整体梯度。
standard.whenToUse: 训练后期变慢、想自动保护和微调时用 population。
standard.avoidWhen: 没做过对照实验前别开；不支持的值（如 pid）启动直接报错。

standard_en.summary: The Training Pilot watches gradient norms and scales the learning rate when something looks off. This selects the strategy; off disables the whole feature.
standard_en.effect: Default off = nothing changes (the historical declared default 'population' was re-defaulted to reality). population = additionally watches outlier layers; heuristic = global gradient rules only.
standard_en.whenToUse: Use population for late-stage slowdowns or protective modulation.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not enable without a controlled comparison; unsupported values (e.g. pid) fail closed at startup.
